campaign_summary: Three distinct voices exploring commission-free ETF trading — from serene reflections to competitive confrontations to whimsical market dances.

concepts.name: The Ripple Effect
concepts.strategic_idea: Embrace the natural rhythm of fee-free trading — where each investment is like a drop creating endless rings of opportunity.

visual_direction.description: Gentle ripples expanding outwards from a single impact point in a dark navy pool, reflections of soft light creating a meditative atmosphere.
